_readme: Hand-edited source of the six built-in release workflow definitions. Run python3 scripts/build-release-workflows.py --write after editing; never edit workflows/release*.json by hand.

train-claim.name: Claim the release train
train-claim.summary: Claim the release train so only one session runs it.

tower-claim.name: Claim release clearance
tower-claim.summary: Claim release clearance from the tower, waiting while another release holds it.

ground-truth.name: Read ground truth
ground-truth.summary: Fetch both branches and read what other sessions landed.

release-shape.name: Read the release shape
release-shape.summary: Say whether this release is new, an open release to adopt, or a merged one to close out.

ci-hold-proof.name: Prove the CI hold
ci-hold-proof.summary: Prove pull-request CI waits for the ready flip before a release opens.

train-finish-earlier.name: Finish the earlier train
train-finish-earlier.summary: Finish the items an earlier merged release train carried.

ship-plan.name: Gather the ship plan
ship-plan.summary: Wait a bounded time for work a peer says is nearly ready for the train.

train-snapshot.name: Snapshot the release train
train-snapshot.summary: Cut a snapshot of the release train merged with the release source.

train-pr.name: Open the train pull request
train-pr.summary: Open the release train's pull request into the release source.

train-review.name: Review the train
train-review.summary: Review what no landing receipt covers on the train pull request.

train-pre-ship.name: Pre-ship checks on the train
train-pre-ship.summary: Run the local pre-ship checks the train needs.

train-merge.name: Merge the train
train-merge.summary: Merge the train pull request through the merge gate, never a push.

train-close-out.name: Close out the train
train-close-out.summary: Mark the one-offs the train carried as reached.

train-level.name: Level the train
train-level.summary: Bring the release train level with the release source.

train-level-after-cut.name: Level the train after the cut
train-level-after-cut.summary: Bring the release train level with the release source.

train-level-final.name: Level the train at the end
train-level-final.summary: Bring the release train level with the release source.

release-delta.name: Work out the release delta
release-delta.summary: Work out what the release carries and check its holds.

classify-release.name: Classify the release
classify-release.summary: Say whether the release is light or full; anything unclear is full.

queue.name: Wait in the release queue
queue.summary: Wait in the release queue behind any older release pull request.

queue-final.name: Wait in the queue at the final gate
queue-final.summary: Wait in the release queue behind any older release pull request.

cut-branch.name: Cut the release branch
cut-branch.summary: Cut the protected release branch from the release source.

production-in-branch.name: Bring production into the branch
production-in-branch.summary: Merge production into the release branch when it is behind.

open-release-pr.name: Open the release pull request
open-release-pr.summary: Open the release pull request into production as a draft.

train-claim-hand-on.name: Hand on the train claim
train-claim-hand-on.summary: Hand the train claim on once the cut exists so the next release can start.

checks-tip.name: Read the production tip
checks-tip.summary: Record the production tip the checks run against.

classify-at-checks.name: Classify at the checks head
classify-at-checks.summary: Classify the release again at the head the checks test.

pre-ship-at-checks.name: Pre-ship checks before the tower
pre-ship-at-checks.summary: Run the release's pre-ship checks before claiming the tower.

dev-deploy-wait.name: Wait for the staging deploy
dev-deploy-wait.summary: Wait for the staging deploy of the release commit to be serving.

pre-merge-at-checks.name: Pre-merge check at the checks head
pre-merge-at-checks.summary: Ask whether production needs anything before the merge, at the checks head.

checks-stamp.name: Stamp the checks
checks-stamp.summary: Stamp the head, tree and production tip the checks passed on.

release-review.name: Review the release
release-review.summary: Run the full production-release review and settle it.

classify-at-pre-ship.name: Classify before the pre-ship checks
classify-at-pre-ship.summary: Classify the release again at the reviewed head before the pre-ship checks.

pre-ship-release.name: Run the pre-ship checks
pre-ship-release.summary: Run the release's pre-ship checks at the reviewed head.

discharge-hold.name: Discharge the pre-ship hold
discharge-hold.summary: Discharge the review's pre-ship hold, which flips the pull request ready once.

docs-plan.name: Plan the documentation
docs-plan.summary: Plan which documentation hooks run after the deploy is confirmed.

hotfix-catch-up.name: Catch up with any hotfix
hotfix-catch-up.summary: Merge a hotfix that reached production into the release branch.

previous-release-gate.name: Check the previous release
previous-release-gate.summary: Check the previous release's post-deploy status before merging.

previous-release-recheck.name: Check the previous release again
previous-release-recheck.summary: Check the previous release's post-deploy status before merging.

pre-merge-check.name: Pre-merge check
pre-merge-check.summary: Ask whether production needs anything before the merge.

pre-merge-recheck.name: Pre-merge check again
pre-merge-recheck.summary: Ask the pre-merge question again once the tower is claimed.

dev-deploy-before-decision.name: Wait for the staging deploy before the decision
dev-deploy-before-decision.summary: Wait for the staging deploy of the release commit to be serving.

dev-deploy-after-yes.name: Wait for the staging deploy after the yes
dev-deploy-after-yes.summary: Wait for the staging deploy of the release commit to be serving.

go-ahead.name: Owner go-ahead
go-ahead.summary: Show the recap and take the owner's yes or the standing yes before the production merge.

go-ahead-recheck.name: Owner go-ahead again
go-ahead-recheck.summary: Show the recap and take the owner's yes or the standing yes before the production merge.

stamp-verify.name: Verify the checks stamp
stamp-verify.summary: Verify the checks stamp still matches the branch and production.

stamp-verify-final.name: Verify the checks stamp once more
stamp-verify-final.summary: Verify the checks stamp still matches the branch and production.

rerun-at-merge.name: Re-run checks at the merge
rerun-at-merge.summary: Re-run the pre-ship entries marked to run again at the merge.

merge-confirmations.name: Confirm before the merge
merge-confirmations.summary: Confirm the head, CI, pre-ship results, threads and tower before the merge.

production-merge.name: Merge to production
production-merge.summary: Merge the release into production through the merge gate, never a push.

post-pending-status.name: Post the pending status
post-pending-status.summary: Post the pending post-deploy status on the merge commit.

approve-deploy.name: Approve the deploy
approve-deploy.summary: Approve the production deploy of the merge commit where approval is configured.

confirm-deploy.name: Confirm the deploy
confirm-deploy.summary: Confirm the production deploy of the merge commit finished.

score-estimates.name: Score estimates
score-estimates.summary: Score the estimates the shipped items carried.

hand-back-after-deploy.name: Hand back the tower after the deploy
hand-back-after-deploy.summary: Hand release clearance back to the tower, naming what is still owed.

tower-hand-back.name: Hand back the tower
tower-hand-back.summary: Hand release clearance back to the tower, naming what is still owed.

post-deploy-status.name: Post the health result
post-deploy-status.summary: Post the health check's result as the release/post-deploy status.

sync-production.name: Sync production back
sync-production.summary: Sync production back into the release source.

delete-release-branch.name: Delete the release branch
delete-release-branch.summary: Delete the release branch once both branches contain it.

update-docs.name: Update documentation
update-docs.summary: Publish documentation for the shipped release and settle the docs owed item.

sync-knowledge-base.name: Sync the knowledge base
sync-knowledge-base.summary: Refresh the knowledge base after documentation was published.

post-deploy-close-out.name: Close out the release
post-deploy-close-out.summary: Run the post-deploy close-out when the health check said one is owed.

write-release-notes.name: Write release notes
write-release-notes.summary: Write release notes, only when they were asked for.

release-recap.name: Recap the release
release-recap.summary: Write the plain-language recap of the release.

auto-start-next.name: Decide the next release
auto-start-next.summary: Decide whether the next release starts now.

merged-release.name: Find the merged release
merged-release.summary: Find the newest merged release and recompute its delta.
